ops.title: Activate the durable IO releases on the root Mac in an owner-authorized restart window
ops.description: Released but inactive on the root Mac (2026-10-17): synckit v0.42.0 (CLI installed, serve 49648 still runs the staged 0.41.2 build), cookiesync v0.32.0 (cask 0.31.2; state.json watch_debounce already 10s), cci v0.21.0 (plugin, cask, ~/.local/bin and daemon 46700 all 0.20.7). Each activation restarts a protected service: synckitd install drains and relaunches serve and reloads reconcile; brew upgrade --cask cookiesync runs cookiesync install, which boots out and re-bootstraps the helper agent (30801) and Ensures serve; cci upgrade or a plugin/cask update makes the daemon hand off within 30s, and cci mesh enable Ensures the daemon. Order: synckitd install, then cookiesync cask (its postflight writes the 10s from state), then cci upgrade on every Mac in the pair before one cci mesh enable per Mac. Receipts: ~/.local/state/host-pressure-recovery/2026-10-17-0620/durable-io-*.json

ops.text: owner authorizes the restart window naming serve, the cookiesync helper and the cc-inbox daemon
serve reports build 0.42.0 and cci.json/cookiesync.json registered debounces stay 5s/10s
cci daemon and both Macs run 0.21.0; cci mesh status shows the new fingerprint on both peers
records item no longer wakes on blobs/ writes (synckitd watch evidence)
